newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's President Emil Constantinescu had talks in Brussels with Belgium's King Albert. Constantinescu will met NATO chief Javier Solana later today.
* Romania's government held informal meeting to discuss stage of negotations on a reform package with international financial institutions.
* Lower Chamber of Deputies debates draft law on road traffic code.
* Upper Senate house debates bill on wine and vineyards.
